args.description: Pixel Heaven native pixel art. Slightly overhead 3/4 RPG view, orthogonal ground (not isometric diamond), upper-left light, crisp 1px clusters, selective dark outlines, warm muted limited palette. Transparent background, no text, no watermark, no scene or ground platform, entire silhouette inside canvas. Wolf head warning emblem; centered readable pixel UI icon, no lettering, no square frame.
